description: This file defines a test case class `TerminalTest` for verifying the behavior of the `matchbox-terminal` package within an embedded Linux testing framework. It contains a test method `test_terminal_running` that starts a terminal process, checks for its existence, and terminates it, leveraging threading and specific decorators for dependencies.

classes.name: TerminalTest
classes.description: A test case class that inherits from `OERuntimeTestCase` to verify terminal process behavior in an embedded environment.

methods.name: test_terminal_running(self)
methods.description: Test method that starts a matchbox-terminal, verifies its process, and then kills it to ensure only one terminal is running.
